cases.translation: The portion of Joseph began at the Jordan of Jericho.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The inheritance went from Bethel to Luz.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: It passed through to the lands of the Arkites.
cases.explain: The preposition к with the verb переходил (to pass through) takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: The boundary went out to the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The boundary was in the east from the Jordan.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: It descended to Beth Horon mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) with the verb спускалась takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Граница примыкала к ___ и выходила к Иордану.
cases.translation: The boundary reached Jericho and went out to the Jordan.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The land was encompassed by Joshua's authority.
cases.explain: The genitive case follows the preposition в when indicating possession or authority.

reading.ru: Надел Иосифа начинался у Иордана Иерихонского, к востоку от Иерихонских вод, и тянулся оттуда через пустыню до Нагории Вифиля.
reading.question: Where did the inheritance of Joseph begin?
options: At the Jordan at Jericho, east of Jericho's waters, extending through the wilderness to Bethel's hill country
At Mount Sinai, south of the Dead Sea
At the Mediterranean Sea, north of Tyre
At the city of Shiloh, in the central highlands
reading.correct: At the Jordan at Jericho, east of Jericho's waters, extending through the wilderness to Bethel's hill country
reading.explain: The text states the lot began у Иордана Иерихонского (at the Jordan at Jericho) and extended к востоку от Иерихонских вод (east of Jericho's waters).

reading.ru: Монассия и Ефрем, потомки Иосифа, получили свой удел.
reading.question: Whose descendants received their inheritance?
options: Manasseh and Ephraim, descendants of Joseph
The sons of Jacob and Leah
The tribes of Israel and Judah
The children of Reuben and Simeon
reading.correct: Manasseh and Ephraim, descendants of Joseph
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Монассия и Ефрем, потомки Иосифа, получили свой удел (Manasseh and Ephraim, descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance).

reading.ru: Еще он включал все города с окрестными поселениями, которые были отделены ефремитом в уделе моноситов.
reading.question: What did the inheritance of Ephraim include in addition to its territory?
options: All the cities with surrounding villages that were set apart within Manasseh's inheritance
All the major fortified cities of Canaan
The cities of the Canaanites on the coast
The cities in the Jordan valley
reading.correct: All the cities with surrounding villages that were set apart within Manasseh's inheritance
reading.explain: The text states он включал все города с окрестными поселениями, которые были отделены ефремитом в уделе моноситов (it included all cities with surrounding villages that were set apart within Manasseh's inheritance).

reading.ru: Они не выселили хананеев, живущих в Гезере.
reading.question: Which inhabitants were not driven out from their city?
reading.explain: The text says Они не выселили хананеев, живущих в Гезере (They did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer).

reading.ru: До сегодняшнего дня хананеи живут среди ефремитов, но как подневольные.
reading.question: What was the status of the Canaanites living among Ephraim?
options: They were enslaved and forced to labor
They were equal citizens with full rights
They had returned to their homeland
reading.correct: They were enslaved and forced to labor
reading.explain: The text states хананеи живут среди ефремитов, но как подневольные (the Canaanites live among Ephraim, but as enslaved people).

reading.ru: Его граница шла оттуда на юг к жителям Эн-Тапуаха.
reading.question: In which direction did the boundary go from the northern point?
options: South toward the inhabitants of En Tappuah
North toward the Sea of Galilee
reading.correct: South toward the inhabitants of En Tappuah
reading.explain: The text states граница шла оттуда на юг к жителям Эн-Тапуаха (the boundary went from there south toward the inhabitants of En Tappuah).
